news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.5x net interest cover). news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.15 (vs ₹0.78 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.15 (up from ₹0.78 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹557.4m (down 11% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹17.1m (up 46% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.1% (up from 1.9% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 3 non-independent directors. Independent Non-Executive Director Priyanka Oka was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
